'''Troll generals''' are huge and powerful [[troll|giant trolls]] that live in [[Troll Stronghold (area)|Troll Stronghold]], on the top floor.

==Strategy==
[[File:Safespotting Troll General.png|thumb|left|250px|One of the safespots]]
Troll generals have a reasonably high drop rate of [[nature rune]]s. This can be advantageous for players wishing to [[high alch]] the generals' salvage drops for profit. Herbs can be noted with the [[Tool leprechaun]] on top of the stronghold, provided that [[My Arm's Big Adventure]] has been completed. However, there are more profitable alternative methods of training. 

As a [[slayer task]], Troll generals are a convenient, higher-level choice when assigned [[troll]]s. They have a reasonably high drop rate of nature runes and weapons and armour, including the occasional [[granite shield]], and are a very easy 89.4 [[Slayer]] experience for medium level players.

It is possible to use magic attacks on the generals safely, as their large size allows them to be corner safe-spotted. Players with 50+ [[Magic]] and [[Defence]] should have no problem killing these quickly and safely, using only [[Regenerate]] or other healing abilities in place of food.

==Trivia==
* Until [[February]] [[2012]], there used to be two level 113 generals and one level 171 general with identical combat statistics aside from their level. The two level 113 generals later had their combat levels increased to 130. After the [[Evolution of Combat]], all three generals were given identical combat levels.
